patches.old:
<!-- Privacy-friendly analytics by Plausible -->
  <script async src="https://plausible.io/js/pa-2yMvoQPYNHnCQ4VVrJlNU.js"></script>
  <script>
    window.plausible=window.plausible||function(){(plausible.q=plausible.q||[]).push(arguments)},plausible.init=plausible.init||function(i){plausible.o=i||{}};
    plausible.init()
  </script>
patches.why: Remove the Plausible analytics script and its stub: no third-party tracking, and the CSP would refuse the script anyway.
Do not build the public inventory.zone origin into canonical, Open Graph and sitemap metadata; this copy is not that site (upstream's own empty override).
Do not emit the 50-odd static handbook and guide pages: they carry Plausible and the hosted SDK on every page, link to the root of the host, and are marketing for the public site.

Do not pre-render the public landing page (promotional links to other sites and to /docs/ and /guides/) into index.html; the app builds the signed-out view itself, and behind Homestead sign-in is always present.
Remove the Documentation and Guides links: they point at the host root (/docs/, /guides/), where no handbook is served.
